exposure: Distance between lesion and incisal margin in conization specimens
Choice between total hysterectomy and clinical observation for patients with lesions ≤3 mm from the incisal margin
cohort: The cohort consisted of 240 patients diagnosed with high-grade squamous intraepithelial lesion (HSIL) who underwent conization and had negative incisal margins.
finding: Different distances between conization tissue lesions and incisal margins did not significantly impact the prognosis (HPV and TCT positive rates) of HSIL patients with negative conization biopsy tissues, suggesting that excessive hysterectomy is not recommended for lesions close to incisal margins (≤3 mm).
